w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something pads into the clearing — The Redactor. It's here.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "TONIGHT: Small Claims. Alien judges settle village disputes. The gavel is a meteorite. Justice is swift, final, and deeply confused by property law."

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Focus Group.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Terms of Service.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE CALLBACK! You're on your own.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Ad Break: Look away when the break runs. Every fourth round it runs the break — repositions, knits itself back together, and WATCHES you watch. Look away. The ad’s power is that you watch; unwatched, the break is just dead air and the healing never lands. (Carlos lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 💥 tiger's Rerun finds you — no dodging it.
firstContext: Too close. The tiger's attention SNAPS to you — proximity overrules patience.
💥 tiger's Rerun finds you — no dodging it.

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: ◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Haul 1,000 kcal to the pantry within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (23/12/8), with 4 wave-4 fought, 8 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 14 · Craft 9 · Talk 14 · Explore 36 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
